utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard anything official—last I heard they were leaning toward Saturday morning, but Maya was supposed to confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—sorry, I’m coming in late; do we at least know if the porch steps and fence are still first, or did the roof get bumped up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand, but I think the porch steps and fence were still the first priority. I haven’t heard anything about the roof getting bumped up yet.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m planning to keep the repair drive at 10 to 2 so it stays clear of school pickup, and I’d really appreciate help making sure pickup families know the timing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That timing works for me; I’ll note the repair drive as 10 to 2 and make sure the pickup families on Maple and Cedar hear it clearly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal—that’s a big help, and I appreciate you making sure Maple and Cedar families hear that we’re keeping it 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the toolkit, spare drill, screws, plus those extension cords and work gloves lined up, Noah. If anything else pops up, give me a shout and I’ll see what I can dig up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great—thanks, Gus, that helps a ton; I’d half-lost track, but I’ve got you down for the toolkit, spare drill, screws, extension cords, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah—I’ll bring the whole lot, and if you realize we’re missing anything else before then, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I still haven’t found that sign-up sheet, Vik, but thanks for keeping folks posted. I’ll tell you the minute it turns up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem, Oren—I’ll keep telling folks the plan and let them know you’re still tracking the sign-up sheet while Rey’s pitching in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik, I really appreciate that — I’m still rummaging through my piles for the sheet, but it’s a comfort knowing Rey can help once I dig it up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Kira—I’m still tracking tape, gloves, and spare screws for the repair drive, and 9 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm whether we’re actually locked for Saturday at 10 instead of 9, and who’s definitely bringing the drill before we finalize it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m only confirmed for 9 so far, not 10, and I’m just tracking tape, gloves, and spare screws—I haven’t got a definite drill person on my list yet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ira, I’m spreading the word that the repair drive’s running 10 to 2 so it works around the school run—could you come by and maybe mention it to a couple of neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I can do that—I’m heading that way anyway, so I’ll stop by, mention the 10 to 2 window, and check the sign-up table while I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Ira—thank you; having you stop by, mention the 10 to 2 window, and keep an eye on the sign-up table will help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Send me the volunteer list when you have it, and I’ll confirm tonight. I’m still good for a 9 start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s a relief, Leo—if you can confirm tonight, I’ll make sure your 9 start is marked clearly so no one’s left guessing in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Mark 9 for now, and I’ll confirm the final volunteer list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard the final confirmation yet, but they were leaning toward Saturday morning last I heard. I’m checking with Maya and I’ll pass it along as soon as she confirms.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules—before I pitch in, can you also confirm whether the roof got moved ahead of the porch steps and fence?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure on the repair order yet, but I can ask Maya about that too when I check on the timing. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey — quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and 9 still looks like a solid start time. I’m locking in the volunteer list and can share it with you this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. Sunday at 9 works for me — send the list when you have it, and I’ll come by if you still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Rey — thank you. I’ll send the volunteer list this afternoon, and I’d love to count you in as an extra set of hands for Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Uli, from what I’ve heard the repair drive’s in decent hands—Mara’s got a sign-in sheet going, and Ben’s checking labels with her tonight so things don’t get muddled.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s good to hear. I’ll still stop by for a little while and mention it to a couple of neighbors, just like I said.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be lovely, Uli—every little nudge helps, and from what I hear they’re asking folks to label anything they drop off now, so it’s all staying much tidier.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, do you know how many volunteers we actually have so far, and how many can handle tools versus just setup or cleanup?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I don’t have the headcount in front of me, Mina, so let’s get a simple list tonight with names and what each person can handle. Once we sort tool work from setup and cleanup, we’ll know exactly where we stand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—can you pull that list together tonight and text me the headcount plus who can actually handle tools?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Looks like Saturday at 10, and I’ve got the basic tools covered. I’m just checking whether Malik’s still bringing the drill.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday at 10 still works for me, and I’ll bring my ladder, hammer, and measuring tape. If Malik confirms the drill, we should be set to start with Maple and Cedar.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that should cover us—if Malik confirms the drill, we’re good to kick off with Maple and Cedar.
